proposalScope: Replacing per-recipient exclusion membership with an unvalidated per-send HashSet snapshot of caller-owned IReadOnlyList input.
actualOwnerAndProducerEvidence: Original owner with ordinary JsonHubProtocol: a real argument property getter replaces eight entries in the same 16-element array, List or read-only wrapper backing list during the first serialization. One actual transport receives a valid frame; later recipients observe the new exclusions.

Explicit snapshot-input controls call the unchanged owner with a HashSet-to-array copy taken before the same real JSON getter runs. All eight transports receive valid frames. These are input-semantics controls, not an implemented indexed owner or measured shipping candidate.

Original Enumerable.Contains dispatch reaches custom ICollection<string>.Contains twice without enumeration and honors its OrdinalIgnoreCase comparison; only one recipient receives a frame. An explicit Ordinal snapshot-input control enumerates once before sending and sends to both recipients.

Both the original and the captured-default JsonHubProtocol source produce all these observations. The latter is compiled in an isolated 80-file consumer image differing only in the JSON producer DLL/PDB. This is not a whole-current-default SDK/dependency build.
The owning 27-row test class passes, including inherited group-send specification coverage. Actual Pipe backpressure and cancellation checks also pass with both producers.
Untimed instrumented input on actual group sends produces 1, 128 and 2048 yielded exclusion values for group/exclusion dimensions 1x1, 8x16 and 32x64. Instrumentation is not timed.
qualifiedConclusion: IReadOnlyList, IsReadOnly, reference identity and count do not establish immutable per-send input. No independent compatible optimization was selected. Declining this snapshot is not a comparative no-gain result or proof that every alternative optimization is impossible.
unverifiedAlternatives: An index with a genuine ownership or mutation/versioning contract and faithful invalidation.
Immutable-input-specific designs, admission thresholds or other compatible local optimizations supported by actual caller and measurement evidence.
nextAuthorizedMeasurement: One original-only 12-shape diagnostic profile to quantify this box's native synchronous group-send boundary; no improvement percentage or before/after claim.
